title: Synchronize delivery status when order is placed
gherkin:
Given a customer places an order
When the order is confirmed
Then the delivery status should be synchronized to 'pending' across all systems
And the delivery tracking information should be available in the customer portal
rationale: Ensures that delivery lifecycle synchronization begins immediately when an order is placed, maintaining consistency across systems from the start.
generationSummary: Delivery lifecycle synchronization ensures that delivery status and related information are kept in sync across all relevant systems and touchpoints throughout the delivery process lifecycle.

title: Synchronize delivery status when item is picked
gherkin:
Given an order is in the warehouse
When the item is picked for delivery
Then the delivery status should be synchronized to 'picked' across all systems
And the customer should be notified of the status change
rationale: Verifies that delivery status updates are synchronized when items transition through the picking phase of the delivery lifecycle.
generationSummary: Delivery lifecycle synchronization ensures that delivery status and related information are kept in sync across all relevant systems and touchpoints throughout the delivery process lifecycle.

title: Synchronize delivery status when item is packed
gherkin:
Given an item has been picked
When the item is packed for shipment
Then the delivery status should be synchronized to 'packed' across all systems
And the packing information should be reflected in all integrated systems
rationale: Ensures delivery status remains synchronized as items progress through the packing phase of the delivery lifecycle.
generationSummary: Delivery lifecycle synchronization ensures that delivery status and related information are kept in sync across all relevant systems and touchpoints throughout the delivery process lifecycle.

title: Synchronize delivery status when shipment is dispatched
gherkin:
Given an order is packed and ready
When the shipment is dispatched from the warehouse
Then the delivery status should be synchronized to 'dispatched' across all systems
And the tracking number should be synchronized to the customer notification system
rationale: Validates that delivery status synchronization occurs when items leave the warehouse, ensuring all systems reflect the dispatch event.
generationSummary: Delivery lifecycle synchronization ensures that delivery status and related information are kept in sync across all relevant systems and touchpoints throughout the delivery process lifecycle.

title: Synchronize delivery status when item is in transit
gherkin:
Given a shipment has been dispatched
When the item is in transit to the delivery address
Then the delivery status should be synchronized to 'in_transit' across all systems
And the estimated delivery date should be synchronized to all customer-facing systems
rationale: Ensures delivery status is synchronized during the in-transit phase, keeping all systems updated with current delivery progress.
generationSummary: Delivery lifecycle synchronization ensures that delivery status and related information are kept in sync across all relevant systems and touchpoints throughout the delivery process lifecycle.

title: Synchronize delivery status when item is delivered
gherkin:
Given a shipment is in transit
When the item is delivered to the customer
Then the delivery status should be synchronized to 'delivered' across all systems
And the delivery confirmation should be recorded in all integrated systems
rationale: Verifies that delivery status synchronization captures the final delivery event across all systems.
generationSummary: Delivery lifecycle synchronization ensures that delivery status and related information are kept in sync across all relevant systems and touchpoints throughout the delivery process lifecycle.

title: Synchronize delivery status when delivery fails
gherkin:
Given a shipment is in transit
When the delivery attempt fails
Then the delivery status should be synchronized to 'failed' across all systems
And the failure reason should be synchronized to the customer notification system
rationale: Ensures that failed delivery attempts are properly synchronized across all systems to maintain accurate delivery status.
generationSummary: Delivery lifecycle synchronization ensures that delivery status and related information are kept in sync across all relevant systems and touchpoints throughout the delivery process lifecycle.

title: Synchronize delivery status when delivery is reattempted
gherkin:
Given a delivery has failed
When a reattempt is scheduled
Then the delivery status should be synchronized to 'reattempt_scheduled' across all systems
And the new delivery date should be synchronized to all customer-facing systems
rationale: Validates that delivery status synchronization handles reattempt scenarios, keeping all systems informed of retry scheduling.

title: Synchronize delivery status when delivery is cancelled
gherkin:
Given an order is in delivery lifecycle
When the delivery is cancelled
Then the delivery status should be synchronized to 'cancelled' across all systems
And the cancellation reason should be synchronized to all integrated systems
rationale: Ensures that delivery cancellations are properly synchronized across all systems to prevent inconsistent states.
generationSummary: Delivery lifecycle synchronization ensures that delivery status and related information are kept in sync across all relevant systems and touchpoints throughout the delivery process lifecycle.

title: Maintain synchronization consistency across multiple systems
gherkin:
Given a delivery status update occurs
When the status is synchronized to multiple integrated systems
Then all systems should reflect the same delivery status
And the synchronization should complete within the defined SLA
And no system should have conflicting delivery information
rationale: Verifies that delivery lifecycle synchronization maintains consistency across all integrated systems without conflicts or delays.
generationSummary: Delivery lifecycle synchronization ensures that delivery status and related information are kept in sync across all relevant systems and touchpoints throughout the delivery process lifecycle.
